# Management API

Manage sites, servers, robots, contracts and deployments. Version `1.0.0-alpha.1`.

The single public API used by the console, CLI, SDK and customer automation (design §20). It is never on the robot action path.

Conventions:
- Resources have `metadata`, `spec` (desired, client-set) and `status` (observed, site-reported, read-only).
- Every POST requires `Idempotency-Key`, except read-only computations marked as such.
- PATCH and DELETE require `If-Match` with the resource version.
- Site-dependent work returns `202` with an Operation that succeeds only on site acknowledgement.
- Errors are RFC 9457 problem details with a stable `reason` code.
- Lists are cursor-paginated.

Status: implemented (M3, extended in M4 and M5).

The machine-readable specification is [`api/openapi.yaml`](https://github.com/rkd0608/neura/blob/main/api/openapi.yaml); the [Python SDK](./sdk.md) is generated from it.

### Upgrade a server's site agent to a signed release

`POST /v1/servers/{server_id}/agent-upgrades` · operation `upgradeAgent`

A signed agent release for one server (design §17.3). The site verifies the bundle against the release keys its installer pinned and applies it only if its operator allows remote upgrades (NEURA_AGENT_ALLOWED_OPERATIONS); it switches when every robot is between tasks and rolls back by itself if the new release does not reconnect. Requires the admin role.

| Parameter | In | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `server_id` | path | yes |  |
| `Idempotency-Key` | header | yes | Required on every POST. A repeated key with the same body returns the original result; with a different body it returns API_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED. |

Request body: `application/json`, `AgentUpgradeCreate`.

Responses: `202`, `401`, `403`, `404`, `413`, `422`, `428`, `429`, `500`, `503`.

### Add a publisher signature to a model artifact

`POST /v1/model-artifacts/{model_artifact_id}/signatures` · operation `addModelArtifactSignature`

Verifies the signature against the artifact's digest and keeps one signature per key. The document and its digest do not change; the resource version does when a signature is new.

| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `model_artifact_id` | path | yes |  |
| `Idempotency-Key` | header | yes | Required on every POST. A repeated key with the same body returns the original result; with a different body it returns API_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED. |

Request body: `application/json`, `ArtifactSignature`.

Responses: `200`, `401`, `403`, `404`, `413`, `422`, `428`, `429`, `500`, `503`.

## Events

### Stream change events (server-sent events)

`GET /v1/projects/{project_id}/events` · operation `streamEvents`

Resumable with `Last-Event-ID` or `cursor` within the retention window. Each SSE message's data is an Event (design §20.6).

| Parameter | In | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `project_id` | path | yes |  |

### Evaluate a candidate revision against the one it would replace

`POST /v1/deployments/{deployment_id}/evaluations` · operation `createEvaluation`

Creates an Evaluation and an Operation. The deployment's site runs it, on its own data and hardware, in the worker sandbox and never on a GPU that serves robots: in simulation on the same scenes for both models, or on episodes the site's robots recorded (design §28.3). The episodes never leave the site; the report does.

| `deployment_id` | path | yes |  |

### Fine-tune a revision's model on episodes recorded at its site

`POST /v1/deployments/{deployment_id}/training-jobs` · operation `createTrainingJob`

Creates a TrainingJob and an Operation. The site snapshots the episodes the filter selects, fine-tunes the base revision's model on them in the worker sandbox, and signs the result as a new artifact with its lineage; its weights stay at the site (design §28.4). On success the new artifact and its execution profile are registered and a candidate revision is created in the deployment, to prepare, evaluate and activate like any other.

| Parameter | In | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `deployment_id` | path | yes |  |
| `Idempotency-Key` | header | yes | Required on every POST. A repeated key with the same body returns the original result; with a different body it returns API_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED. |

Request body: `application/json`, `TrainingJobCreate`.

Responses: `202`, `401`, `403`, `404`, `409`, `413`, `422`, `428`, `429`, `500`, `503`.

## Weights

### Upload a sealed weight file to Neura's registry

`PUT /v1/projects/{project_id}/sealed-weights/{digest}` · operation `uploadSealedWeights`

The body is a file sealed with `neura-contracts seal`, for the plaintext digest in the path. The control plane checks its header and length but cannot decrypt it. Uploading again replaces the file (after re-sealing with a new key, for example). Returns 404 when this control plane runs no registry.

| Parameter | In | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `project_id` | path | yes |  |
| `digest` | path | yes | The plaintext weight file's digest, as the model artifact lists it (sha256:&lt;hex&gt;). |

Request body: `application/octet-stream`, `string`.

Responses: `200`, `201`, `401`, `403`, `404`, `422`, `429`, `500`, `503`.

Sites that already opened it keep their verified copy; no site can fetch it afterwards.

Responses: `204`, `401`, `403`, `404`, `412`, `422`, `428`, `429`, `500`, `503`.

### Deploy a policy version to robots, try one on a bench robot, or roll robots back

`POST /v1/projects/{project_id}/rollouts` · operation `createRollout`

The rollout's steps then advance with the site's reports (design §29.4): it checks the version fits the robots, the site prepares and times it on its GPU, it runs beside the current version on live observations when asked, a person at the site approves, and the robots switch at their next task boundary. No credential in the cloud can approve: only the site does.

| Parameter | In | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `project_id` | path | yes |  |
| `Idempotency-Key` | header | yes | Required on every POST. A repeated key with the same body returns the original result; with a different body it returns API_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED. |

Request body: `application/json`, `RolloutCreate`.

Responses: `201`, `401`, `403`, `404`, `409`, `413`, `422`, `428`, `429`, `500`, `503`.
